input.project_card:
Idea (user's words): A B2B inventory tool for pharmacies: shop owners track stock and expiry dates and reorder from their wholesalers when medicines run low.
Category: B2B inventory management for retail pharmacies. Geography: Pune and Nashik, India. Language: en.
input.fact_digest:
FCT-001 [context|customers] Customers are independent pharmacy owners (from the first message)
FCT-002 [rule|expiry] Owners must see which medicines are close to expiry (from the first message)
FCT-003 [rule|pricing] Shops pay a monthly subscription (from Q-001)
FCT-004 [context|location] Launch in Pune first, Nashik later (from Q-002)
FCT-005 [role|staff] A shop owner and one counter assistant use it (from Q-003)
input.asked_list:
Q-001 how shops pay (answered)
Q-002 where it launches (answered)
Q-003 who uses it in a shop (answered)
input.last_qa:
Q-001 Do shops pay a monthly fee, pay per reorder, or does the wholesaler pay? -> A monthly fee
Q-003 Who in a shop will use it? -> The owner and one assistant at the counter

questions.intent: learn what the tool should do when stock is close to expiry
unlocks: Blueprint: expiry alerts and returns flow
questions.answer_spec: What each feature is for and what must be in the first release
questions.text: When a medicine is close to expiry, should the tool only warn the shop, or also help return it to the wholesaler?
questions.why_we_ask: It decides whether the first version includes a returns flow.

options.label: Warn and prepare a return to the wholesaler
options.reason: It saves the shop the manual return paperwork

options.label: Warn, and stop it being sold at the counter

questions.recommended: Warn and prepare a return to the wholesaler

questions.intent: learn whether batch numbers are tracked for every pack
questions.answer_spec: Whether batch numbers are tracked, and for which medicines
questions.text: Do shops need to record batch numbers for every pack, or only for certain medicines?
questions.why_we_ask: Batch tracking changes how stock is entered at the counter.

options.label: Only for controlled or high-risk medicines

questions.intent: learn what happens when stock runs low
questions.answer_spec: Which outside services to connect, and what each is for
questions.text: When stock runs low, should the tool send the order to the wholesaler, or only prepare a list for the owner to send?
questions.why_we_ask: Sending orders directly means connecting to each wholesaler.

options.label: Send the order to the wholesaler directly
Prepare a list; the owner sends it
options.reason: The owner stays in control of what is ordered

questions.recommended: Prepare a list; the owner sends it

questions.intent: learn how shops keep their stock records today
unlocks: Blueprint: import of existing stock lists
questions.answer_spec: Existing systems, spreadsheets or APIs to connect to, and what each holds
questions.text: Where do shops keep their stock list today, and in what form?
questions.why_we_ask: If a list already exists, the tool can start from it instead of from zero.
examples: e.g. a billing software the shop already uses

assumed_instead.assumption: No patient or prescription data is stored; only stock and supplier data
assumed_instead.reason: The tool tracks medicines, not people; shown for approval

expert_gaps: Return and credit-note handling with wholesalers
